YouTuber Arrested Again Under UAPA in Andhra Pradesh

YouTuber Prashna Raavan has been arrested for the fifth time in Andhra Pradesh, this time under the stringent Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act (UAPA). The details of the specific charges leading to this arrest under UAPA were not provided in the coverage. This marks a repeated instance of his apprehension by authorities.
